answer: A peer-attestation trellis mitigates Sybil attacks by routing identity validation across mutual credit graphs. To participate, an agent locks a scarce jade deposit, forming a verifiable pearl of bonded collateral that slashes upon misbehavior. This forces an attacker to pay genuine capital for each forged identity. However, the system inherently disadvantages capital-constrained autonomous agents and cannot deter well-funded cartels willing to absorb collateral losses.
